objective: Predict changes in observed class-price discounts over 24/60/120 calendar months; not a required-return discount-rate estimate
fx_semantics: Exact observed ECB daily references, foreign units per EUR; retrospective monthly price-gap definition, not synchronous executable parity
coverage_denominator: Supplied weekday rows from earlier nine-panel outer calendar joins; not certified exchange sessions
forecast_origin: First calendar day after the completed feature month; assume monthly price/volume known then, original historical delivery vintages unavailable

models.hypothesis: Persistent relative-price states contain horizon-specific correction information beyond no change
A trailing state change adds information beyond the present discount; test without activity before attributing incremental activity value
Relative trading activity adds information beyond current discount and trailing state; compare LH-ACTIVITY to LH-STATE on identical origins, not as a causal liquidity-cost test

training_labels: Strictly earlier origin months, with terminal month no later than the current completed feature month
inference: Exploratory calendar-grid HAC(h) coefficients; no confirmatory p-values; report anchored nonoverlapping outcomes and dependence
evaluation: Retrospective expanding pseudo-out-of-sample on common origins with training-only fit; all historical data exposed; no tuning on losses
missing_data_policy: Exclude isolated invalid daily prices; no future backfill, no interpolated labels, exact calendar endpoints and explicit missing months
known_limitations: Historical venue continuity and vendor price-status dictionary incomplete
ADS ratios are documented matched-basis assumptions, not blanket interval certification
No cashflow valuation identifies a required return
Pooled issuer causality and executable arbitrage not tested
